newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hokkaido Takushoku shares bid-only on tie-up news.
newsitem.headline: Hokkaido Takushoku shares bid-only on tie-up news.

text.p: Shares in Hokkaido Takushoku Bank Ltd were bid-only on Tuesday morning, after the news on Monday that the bank and Barclays Bank have agreed to begin discussions on several areas of cooperation, traders said.
At 0026 GMT, Hokkaido Takushoku's shares were bid-only at 154 yen, against Tuesday's close of 144 yen.

Barclays and Hokkaido Takushoku said in a news conference on Monday that they were discussing cooperation in such areas as the development of new financial products and securitisation of Hokkaido Takushoku's assets.
